metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.4 · 2010 · The Expendables
metas.description: A CIA operative hires a team of mercenaries to eliminate a Latin dictator and a renegade CIA agent.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.6 · 2012 · The Expendables 2
metas.description: Mr. Church reunites the Expendables for what should be an easy paycheck, but when one of their men is murdered on the job, their quest for revenge puts them deep in enemy territory and up against an unexpected threat.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.1 · 2014 · The Expendables 3
metas.description: Barney augments his team with new blood for a personal battle: to take down Conrad Stonebanks, the Expendables co-founder and notorious arms trader who is hell bent on wiping out Barney and every single one of his associates.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 4.8 · 2023 · The Expendables 4
metas.description: Armed with every weapon they can get their hands on, the Expendables are the world's last line of defense and the team that gets called when all other options are off the table.
